input.script: This demo is to explain how a user is supposed to create a form. Step 1: Type Birthday RSVP in the box under the What do you want to ask Section, Step 2: Click on Create it Free, Step 3: After the new page loads, type Allen's Birthday under the Description text box, Step 4: Click on Add your first question, Step 5: Under the dropdown which says single Line text choose Yes/no, Step 6: In the Question text box type allergies and hit the check-box next to the Required text, Step 7: Click on Save Changes

beats.title: Form title
beats.action: Type Birthday RSVP into the text box under the heading What do you want to ask.
beats.targetText: What do you want to ask
beats.narration: The form starts with a title. Birthday RSVP is what this survey is about.

beats.title: Create it free
beats.action: Click the button labeled Create it free.
beats.narration: Create it free opens the builder so the survey can be edited on the next page.

beats.title: Description
beats.action: Type Allen's Birthday into the Description text box.
beats.narration: Description tells guests this RSVP is for Allen's Birthday.

beats.title: Add first question
beats.narration: Add your first question opens the control for choosing a question type.

beats.title: Yes/no type
beats.action: Open the question type dropdown that says Single line text and choose Yes/no.
beats.narration: Yes or no is the question type, so guests can answer with a simple choice.

beats.title: Allergies required
beats.action: Type allergies into the Question text box, then check the checkbox labeled Required.
beats.narration: The question asks about allergies and Required means every guest has to answer.

beats.title: Save Changes
beats.narration: Save Changes stores the form so the Birthday RSVP is ready to share.
